description: Non-material amendment to planning permission 25/05983 (Creation of 6no roof terraces with balustrades. Addition of balustrades to 1no existing roof terrace. Alterations to existing windows. Creation doors to access roof terraces and roof-top plant area with acoustic screening. Blocking up 3no existing windows. Installation of: air source heat pump; plant and gates within existing plant areas on 1st and 3rd floors; inner acoustic screens) to allow the acceptance of revised drawings, showing: the omission of the rooftop plant area with acoustic screening and the omission of the doors accessing the rooftop plant area; relocation of the external air source heat pump plant to the existing first floor plant area; minor revisions to plant layouts within the first and third floor plant areas; and, the addition of an inner acoustic screen at first floor plant area.
